tonight.headline: Flowers needs 36.8 tonight
body: Bad news first. Garrett Wilson's quarterback is having tests on his ankle and starts at the Chargers only if healthy; Omar Cooper Jr. may have a high-ankle sprain. Green Bay (your D/ST) and Cleveland (Boston, now nursing a toe) are on bye in Week 11, and Waddle's concussion has had no update since 10 November.
The game: all nine starters are final at 136.94. Nicky Jam have only Zay Flowers left, in Baltimore–LA Chargers at 19:15 CDMX, projected 14.6. ESPN gives you 99%. Nothing to set.

case.label: Their side
case.body: 100.16 banked. Flowers is their last player, catching from Jacoby Brissett in his first Baltimore start; he has six receiving yards over his last two games (Ravens.com 16 Nov).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Flowers scoring 36.8 or more — two and a half times his projection. Nothing on your side can move.

doFirst.title: Add the Bears D/ST, drop the Packers D/ST
doFirst.subtitle: Green Bay have no game in Week 11; Chicago host the Saints off their bye.

case.label: The need
case.body: Packers D/ST are on bye in Week 11 (Packers.com 15 Nov), so the slot scores zero unless it changes. The Packers are locked until the week rolls, so the swap waits for that.

case.label: The pick
case.body: Three Week 11 streaming columns published today name Chicago at home against New Orleans: Yahoo's Boone (21:00Z — the Saints allow the ninth-most points to defences; Jeffery Simmons added), Roto Street Journal (26 sacks this season; Shough under heavy pressure) and FantasyPros (seven sacks and four turnovers in their last two games). It is a free agent here — no claim.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Packers D/ST are 50.2% rostered, so this disagrees with the market on the record: they allowed 30 to Minnesota, have no Week 11 game, and Week 12 is at the Rams. STRATEGY §5 streams the D/ST on matchup; the incumbent's zero is the real gap.

case.label: The risk
case.body: A free agent can be taken by anyone before the week rolls. If Chicago are gone, the Broncos D/ST (free agent, at the Raiders and rookie Fernando Mendoza) is the fallback; the Bengals D/ST (Yahoo's top pick, at Washington) is on waivers until Wed 02:00 CDMX, and a Chem claim costs nothing lasting. Week 11 projections are not in this snapshot — Tuesday's brief re-checks the pick against them.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The Bears D/ST score under 5 in Week 11, or the Broncos D/ST — the free-agent alternative named here — outscore them (archive).
